body_markdown:
*Each month, Braze selects one individual as our Marketer of the Month in order to celebrate the exceptional work being done by members of our[Braze Bonfire community](https://community.braze.com/?utm_campaign=fy25-q4-global-owned-web-marketer-of-the-month&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=braze&utm_content=blog-bonfire) . Whether it's providing support for their fellow marketers or going above and beyond by sharing their innovative ideas and strategies, these individuals are making essential contributions to their companies, their users, and the customer engagement space as a whole.*


*This month, we’re recognizing Giovanna Anzola, Growth Retention Lead at Ridery. Born out of a mission to provide reliable urban mobility during a time of severe economic hardship and national fuel shortages, Ridery launched as Caracas's first mobility app. Today, the platform provides critical livelihoods for over 100,000 workers across the country and has successfully mobilized over 3 million Venezuelans.*


*We spoke to Giovanna about her background and what they’re working on at Ridery. Let’s dive in.*


## Tell us about yourself and how you found yourself the job you’re in now.


I’m Giovanna Anzola, Growth Retention Lead at Ridery, a ride-hailing mobility app based in Caracas, Venezuela. I’ve been in Growth for five years, but I actually started as a content creator. I pivoted my career through data analysis after taking Google’s Data Analytics certificate, realizing my true passion in communication was understanding human behavior through data.


To work with large databases, I joined Farmatodo—a massive pharmacy/convenience chain operating their VP Technology team from Colombia in Venezuela—as a marketing analyst. They had a massive 3-million user database and were using Braze and Amplitude. My job was to boost department sales using CRM segmentation and purchase analysis. I loved learning the tech stack there, but I eventually needed a new challenge.


That led me to Ridery, where I had the opportunity to build their Braze and Amplitude architecture from scratch. It has been a demanding and enriching experience to develop a growth strategy from the ground up, and our data-based approach has expanded the business well beyond our initial expectations.


## What company goals have you focused on first and how have you managed to prioritize?


I’ve found that ride frequency is our strongest retention indicator. In ride-hailing, mobility is an everyday need, so high frequency means users are consistently finding value in our product. That is why rides-per-user—stacked in frequency brackets per monthly active user—has become the paramount KPI for our retention squad, prioritizing it even above mere user activation.


We want to understand how we can be there for every part of our customers' needs. By engaging them through both product and CRM marketing experiences to boost loyalty, we’ve driven meaningful, lasting retention, resulting in a 31% MAU YoY growth rate, 34% increased frequency of rides per active user, and 40.7% YoY growth rate in our monthly total rides, resulting in 2.13 million monthly total rides and 383k monthly active users as for September 2026.


We achieved this through an integrated workflow combining product analytics, segmentation, and highly targeted user engagement flows.


## How do you see Braze as a career accelerant?


Braze has been a powerful career accelerator for me and my team because it empowers MarTech professionals to execute highly technical workflows. It operates as a hybrid platform, taking complex engineering and data pipelines and making them dynamic and seamless for low-code professionals. You can literally watch an idea transform into measurable growth within minutes. Having the ability to build complicated data processing and content logic without heavy reliance on engineering allows us to pivot quickly and deliver constant results.


## What initiative or campaign are you most excited to work on this year?


I am incredibly excited to work on our 2026 Year Wrapped campaign. We are bringing a highly personalized and interactive experience to our users by leveraging Braze's recent AI operator and Braze CDI integration to take our engagement and personalization to the next level.


## What is one campaign or initiative you have worked on in the last 1-4 months that you’re most proud of?


I am most proud of the "Ridery Seismic Alert System," an initiative that recently won the[Braze for Impact award](https://www.braze.com/resources/articles/2026-torchie-awards-winners) . On June 24, 2026, a major earthquake struck Venezuela, and we immediately recognized the need to transform our mobility app into an immediate, localized safety net during the crisis. We rapidly developed a real-time Braze API-Triggered Push Campaign connected live to USGS seismic data to keep our users safe and informed.


**Here is how we leveraged Braze to execute the campaign:**


- Dynamic Geographic Targeting: We used the "city" custom attribute as our core segmentation signal. By calculating a dynamic impact radius based on the earthquake's magnitude, we built a Connected Audience filter at runtime to target only users in affected areas, completely preventing alert fatigue in safe regions.
- Time-Sensitive Liquid Personalization: Because local mobile networks frequently fail or delay messages during disasters, we utilized Liquid templates to render the precise local time, magnitude, and depth directly in the push notification. This ensured users knew exactly when the quake happened, even if the alert arrived 15 minutes late.
- Integrated Crisis Relief: Alongside the alerts, we offered free rides to hospitals via promo codes and guaranteed 100% of earnings (zero platform commission) to drivers who stayed on the road to help.


The impact of this initiative was tremendous. Within the first 72 hours, we deployed 1.7 million notifications across our database with critical emergency information. We mobilized over 82,000 emergency aid rides to hospitals and rescue centers, and mitigated our cancellation rate by 20% by stabilizing driver earnings and marketplace trust. As a Growth Marketer with no software engineering background, I am incredibly proud that I was able to design and deploy this production-grade, permanent safety infrastructure in under 24 hours using the Braze API.


I’m also proud to win a $10k fund via Braze for Impact to support Fundaprocura, a foundation in Venezuela that supports people with motor disabilities to gain back their mobility and independence, with the increased casualties and clinical therapy needed in their facility after all the loss and amputations suffered by children and people during the double earthquake in Venezuela.
